nodes.label: Full Reference Config
nodes.rationale: Documented as a reference only, not a template: copying it wholesale pins defaults that may change between versions, so only values differing from defaults should be specified.

nodes.label: Motion Detection Configuration
nodes.rationale: Motion is the gate for object detection so it cannot be disabled while detect is enabled; lightning_threshold exists so scene-wide changes (lightning, IR switch, PTZ move) recalibrate instead of flooding the tracker.

nodes.label: Recording Retention Modes
nodes.rationale: Alert/detection retain modes cannot recover segments a more restrictive camera-level retain mode already discarded, so the camera-level mode must be the least restrictive of the two.

nodes.label: Named Config Profiles
nodes.rationale: Profiles are partial camera overrides toggled at runtime and applied on top of the already-resolved config, so they win over camera and global values without rewriting the config file.

edges.source_location: Sections marked '# NOTE: Can be overridden at the camera level'
